title: Russia said it's delivering Su-57s, its rival to the F-35, to a foreign buyer amid Moscow's war of attrition
summary: Vadim Badekha, CEO of Russia's primary aircraft manufacturer, said two SU-57s were already sent to the buyer and had "begun combat duty."
